chars.COUSIN: COUSIN: a young woman wearing a long dark-green abaya and a cream-colored hijab wrapped around her round white head (face visible).
chars.BOY: BOY: a 17-year-old guy wearing a red hoodie with white drawstrings, blue jeans and white sneakers, a black backpack.
chars.MOM: MOM: a middle-aged woman wearing a mauve djellaba and a light grey headscarf.
chars.SIS: SIS: a small girl wearing a yellow dress and a pink backpack.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: A modest Casablanca apartment living room with a low round table and Moroccan sofas. The cousin sits at the family lunch table eating quietly, very shy, eyes down, hands close to her body, while the mom and the boy eat and glance at her.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Same Moroccan living room. The cousin now laughs out loud cheerfully next to the boy on the sofa, leaning toward him, while the boy looks surprised.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: A small Moroccan kitchen with tiled walls. The cousin smiles warmly and chats with the boy, gesturing as if asking about his day, the boy holds a glass of tea, a bit confused.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The boy sits on his bed in a modest room, scratching his head thinking, puzzled. Through the open door in the background the cousin passes by and gives him a playful smile.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot of the boy in the hallway of the apartment, narrowing his eyes suspiciously, hand on chin, looking toward a closed bedroom door.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: At the apartment front door in the morning, the mom leaves holding the small girl's hand, while the cousin stands inside the doorway waving goodbye with a sly little smile.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan school classroom with empty desks and a blackboard with nothing written on it. The boy stands alone with his backpack, shrugging happily because the teacher is absent.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: A narrow sunny Casablanca street in front of a building door. The boy, sweaty from the heat, knocks on the apartment door with his fist, curious, looking at the door.
